payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the experiments conducted, including tasks and methodologies used to investigate the learning rate warm-up stage in different Transformer architectures.

claims.text: Experiments were conducted on the IWSLT14 German-to-English and WMT14 English-to-German translation tasks to investigate the necessity of the learning rate warm-up stage.
The experiments included training models with different optimizers (Adam and SGD) and varying learning rates to assess the impact of the warm-up stage.
The Pre-LN Transformer was tested to show that it can achieve comparable results without the warm-up stage, thus requiring less training time.
